title: Plate Tectonics
text: Plate tectonics is the scientific theory describing the movement of Earth's lithosphere, which is broken into large rigid plates that float on the semi-fluid mantle beneath. Plates move a few centimeters per year, driven by mantle convection. Their interactions at boundaries -- colliding, separating, or sliding past each other -- cause earthquakes, volcanic activity, and the formation of mountain ranges and ocean trenches.
